data: What is the approximate value of the red line in July-18?

The red line represents the number of users. The y-axis shows the number of users on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis shows the months from June 2018 to May 2019. The red line starts at approximately 208,744 users in June 2018 and increases steadily over time. In July 2018, the red line is slightly above 300,000 users. Therefore, the approximate value of the red line in July 2018 is around 300,000.
